title: centaurea nissana subsp. rivularis
intro: Centaurea nissana subsp. rivularis, commonly known as Rivularia knapweed, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. Rivularia knapweed exhibits therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Rivularia knapweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
